label: fail
title: Bulk import books from CSV
body:
Support bulk catalogue updates:

1. New `src/csv.js` exporting `parseCsv(text)` → array of rows (arrays of strings), RFC 4180: quoted fields, `""` escapes, commas and newlines inside quotes, CRLF or LF line endings, optional trailing newline (no empty trailing row).
2. `POST /books/import` — the request body is the raw CSV **string** (the handler receives it as `req.body`). Header row must contain `id,title,author,price,stock,tags` (any order; extra columns ignored) → otherwise `400 { error }`.
   - `price` is dollars (e.g. `39.99`) → store `priceCents` (rounded); `tags` are `;`-separated (empty → `[]`); `stock` must be a non-negative integer; `id` and `title` are required; price must be a number ≥ 0.
   - Existing ids are updated (title, author, price, tags, and stock set to the given value); new ids are created.
   - Invalid rows are skipped and reported. Response `200 { created, updated, errors: [{ line, message }] }` where `line` is the 1-based line of the CSV text where that record **starts** (quoted fields can span lines).
3. Add tests.
plan:
Add CSV parser and import endpoint to support bulk CSV import of books, plus tests.
1. Add RFC4180 CSV parser src/csv.js
2. Add /books/import handler in src/server.js
3. Add tests for CSV import in test/import.test.js
requirements: Create src/csv.js exporting parseCsv(text) that returns an array of objects { row: string[], startLine: number } and implements RFC 4180 parsing (quoted fields with "" escapes, commas and newlines inside quotes, CRLF or LF endings, optional trailing newline with no empty trailing row).

Add POST /books/import route in src/server.js. The handler accepts req.body as the raw CSV string. Header row must contain the columns id,title,author,price,stock,tags in any order; extra columns ignored. If headers are invalid, respond 400 with { error }.

For each record: parse fields by header mapping. Validate: id and title required; price is a decimal >= 0 and converted to priceCents by rounding to nearest cent (Math.round(price*100)); stock must be a non-negative integer; tags are ; separated (empty→[]). Invalid rows are skipped and included in errors array with their CSV starting line and message. Existing ids are updated (title, author, priceCents, tags, and stock set to given value); new ids are created. Response is 200 with { created, updated, errors: [{ line, message }] }.
Add tests at test/import.test.js covering successful creates and updates and reporting of invalid rows and header validation (400).

- Header matching is exact after trimming and case-sensitive, i.e., header cell must exactly match one of ['id','title','author','price','stock','tags'] (R2 decision). Implemented in src/server.js lines ~41-46.
- Price conversion uses Math.round(price * 100) (R3 decision). Implemented in src/server.js line ~74.
- For creating new books, inventory.add expects positive quantity; after add we set createdBook.stock to the absolute stock from CSV to match requirement.

diff --git a/src/csv.js b/src/csv.js
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..8c39943
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/csv.js
@@ -0,0 +1,105 @@
+// Simple RFC4180 CSV parser returning rows with their starting line number.
+export function parseCsv(text) {
+  const out = []
+  let i = 0
+  const len = text.length
+  let cur = ''
+  let row = []
+  let inQuotes = false
+  let line = 1
+  let rowStartLine = 1
+
+  function pushField() {
+    row.push(cur)
+    cur = ''
+  }
+
+  while (i < len) {
+    const ch = text[i]
+
+    if (inQuotes) {
+      if (ch === '"') {
+        if (i + 1 < len && text[i + 1] === '"') {
+          cur += '"'
+          i += 2
+          continue
+        } else {
+          inQuotes = false
+          i++
+          continue
+        }
+      }
+      // accept any char including CR/LF inside quotes
+      if (ch === '\r') {
+        // handle CRLF or lone CR
+        if (i + 1 < len && text[i + 1] === '\n') {
+          i += 2
+        } else {
+          i++
+        }
+        cur += '\n'
+        line++
+        continue
+      }
+      if (ch === '\n') {
+        i++
+        cur += '\n'
+        line++
+        continue
+      }
+      cur += ch
+      i++
+      continue
+    }
+
+    // not in quotes
+    if (ch === ',') {
+      pushField()
+      i++
+      continue
+    }
+    if (ch === '"') {
+      inQuotes = true
+      i++
+      continue
+    }
+    if (ch === '\r') {
+      // end of record
+      pushField()
+      i++
+      if (i < len && text[i] === '\n') i++
+      out.push({ row, startLine: rowStartLine })
+      row = []
+      rowStartLine = line + 1
+      line++
+      continue
+    }
+    if (ch === '\n') {
+      pushField()
+      i++
+      out.push({ row, startLine: rowStartLine })
+      row = []
+      rowStartLine = line + 1
+      line++
+      continue
+    }
+    // regular char
+    cur += ch
+    i++
+  }
+
+  // EOF
+  // push last field/row if any content or last char was a comma
+  if (inQuotes) {
+    // unterminated quote - treat as end
+    pushField()
+    out.push({ row, startLine: rowStartLine })
+  } else if (cur !== '' || row.length > 0) {
+    pushField()
+    out.push({ row, startLine: rowStartLine })
+  }
+
+  // RFC4180: optional trailing newline means no empty trailing row; we've avoided adding empty final row
+  return out
+}

@@ -29,6 +29,77 @@ export function createApp(inventory = Inventory.fromFile()) {
     return { status: 200, body: { totalCents: total, total: formatCurrency(total) } }
   })
 
+  // Bulk import books from CSV. Body is the raw CSV string.
+  router.post('/books/import', async ({ body }) => {
+    const text = body
+    if (typeof text !== 'string') return { status: 400, body: { error: 'Expected raw CSV string in body' } }
+    const { parseCsv } = await import('./csv.js')
+    const parsed = parseCsv(text)
+    if (parsed.length === 0) return { status: 400, body: { error: 'Empty CSV' } }
+    const header = parsed[0].row.map((h) => (h ?? '').trim())
+    const required = ['id', 'title', 'author', 'price', 'stock', 'tags']
+    const map = new Map()
+    header.forEach((h, idx) => map.set(h, idx))
+    for (const req of required) if (!map.has(req)) return { status: 400, body: { error: 'Invalid header' } }
+
+    let created = 0
+    let updated = 0
+    const errors = []
+    for (let i = 1; i < parsed.length; i++) {
+      const { row, startLine } = parsed[i]
+      const get = (name) => row[map.get(name)] ?? ''
+      const id = (get('id') || '').trim()
+      const title = (get('title') || '').trim()
+      const author = (get('author') || '').trim()
+      const priceRaw = (get('price') || '').trim()
+      const stockRaw = (get('stock') || '').trim()
+      const tagsRaw = get('tags') ?? ''
+
+      if (!id) {
+        errors.push({ line: startLine, message: 'Missing id' })
+        continue
+      }
+      if (!title) {
+        errors.push({ line: startLine, message: 'Missing title' })
+        continue
+      }
+      const price = Number(priceRaw)
+      if (!Number.isFinite(price) || price < 0) {
+        errors.push({ line: startLine, message: 'Invalid price' })
+        continue
+      }
+      const priceCents = Math.round(price * 100)
+      if (!/^[0-9]+$/.test(stockRaw)) {
+        errors.push({ line: startLine, message: 'Invalid stock' })
+        continue
+      }
+      const stock = Number(stockRaw)
+      if (!Number.isInteger(stock) || stock < 0) {
+        errors.push({ line: startLine, message: 'Invalid stock' })
+        continue
+      }
+      const tags = tagsRaw === '' ? [] : String(tagsRaw).split(';').map((t) => t.trim()).filter(Boolean)
+
+      const existing = inventory.find(id)
+      if (existing) {
+        existing.title = title
+        existing.author = author
+        existing.priceCents = priceCents
+        existing.tags = tags
+        existing.stock = stock
+        updated++
+      } else {
+        inventory.add({ id, title, author, priceCents, tags }, stock || 0)
+        const createdBook = inventory.find(id)
+        if (createdBook) {
+          createdBook.stock = stock
+        }
+        created++
+      }
+    }
+    return { status: 200, body: { created, updated, errors } }
+  })
+

+import { test } from 'node:test'
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
+import { createApp } from '../src/server.js'
+import { Inventory } from '../src/inventory.js'
+
+const makeApp = () => createApp(new Inventory())
+
+test('POST /books/import creates and updates and reports errors', async () => {
+  const app = makeApp()
+  const csv = `id,title,author,price,stock,tags
+b1,New Book,Author A,12.34,5,fiction;new
+b2,Existing,Author B,20,3,classic
+bad1,,No Title,10,1,
+bad2,Bad Price,Author,notanum,2,
+`
+  // pre-add b2
+  const inv = new Inventory([{ id: 'b2', title: 'Old', author: 'X', priceCents: 1000, stock: 10 }])
+  const app2 = createApp(inv)
+  const res = await app2({ method: 'POST', url: '/books/import', body: csv })
+  assert.equal(res.status, 200)
+  assert.equal(res.body.created, 1)
+  assert.equal(res.body.updated, 1)
+  assert.equal(res.body.errors.length, 2)
+  // check that b1 was created
+  const b1 = inv.find('b1')
+  assert.equal(b1.title, 'New Book')
+  assert.equal(b1.priceCents, 1234)
+  // check b2 updated
+  const b2 = inv.find('b2')
+  assert.equal(b2.title, 'Existing')
+  assert.equal(b2.priceCents, 2000)
+})
+
+test('POST /books/import rejects invalid header', async () => {
+  const app = makeApp()
+  const csv = `id,Title,author,price,stock,tags\n` // Title capitalized -> header must be exact
+  const res = await app({ method: 'POST', url: '/books/import', body: csv })
+  assert.equal(res.status, 400)
+})
